facts.text: Twin UltraFlex Solar Arrays was deployed at Elysium Planitia during InSight in 2018.

Two 2.15-metre diameter circular fan-fold arrays with ultra-lightweight carbon composite ribs and triple-junction solar cells. They generated 4,600 watt-hours per sol at landing, tapering to 300 watt-hours as dust accumulated.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Demonstrated the durability of UltraFlex circular array designs and provided empirical data on wind-driven dust accumulation rates across multi-year missions.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Elysium Planitia.
The gradual coating of red dust led to poignant final communications that captivated millions around the globe in December 2022.
